news.headline: Palo Alto +3% on Deutsche Bank AI Call as CEO Warns: “More of These, Not Less”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysPalo Alto Networks shares rose 3% today after Deutsche Bank named it one of three standouts among companies set to gain from rising AI usage, while the Nasdaq fell about 2%. CEO Nikesh Arora warned that more AI-found flaws like this week’s PHP bug are coming, and Cloudflare rose [4%] as the cybersecurity rally carried on.

news.headline: Website PHP Flaws Spur a Cybersecurity Stock Rally—but Not All Are Buys
news.summary: Cloudflare and other cybersecurity stocks have gained as website operators rush to patch PHP flaws, but price targets suggest uneven upside.

news.headline: Nebius Declines 6% Despite Fresh Citi Financing; CoreWeave Drops 5%, Cloudflare Edges Higher
news.summary: Citi handed Nebius a fresh credit line to fund its GPU buildout, and investors sold the news anyway. The reaction inside the neocloud group tells a story about leverage, trust, and how much runway debt-funded AI builders actually have left.
